selectedReference: ANSI/ASHRAE/NEMA Standard 201-2016 (RA2026), Facility Smart Grid Information Model

assetFamilyPatterns.family: Electrical consumers: HVAC, lighting, appliances, industrial and ICT equipment
Electrical sources: PV, wind and dispatchable generation
Electricity measurement and declared measurement boundaries
Passive distribution, protection and communications support
Weather, market, carbon and threat information

opcuaDIBridge.sourceAndProjectIdentifiers: Preserve namespace URI, NodeId, equipment identifiers and project asset ID as scoped aliases; do not assume string equality proves identity.

accountingRules: A device may expose several energy functions; storage has charge Load and discharge Generator roles with explicit modes.
PV, storage and EV conversion-chain members share an accounting group; do not sum multiple views of the same flow.
Choose explicit PCC/submeter boundaries, units, signs, time windows and aggregation hierarchy before computing facility totals.
Do not infer zero losses or energy consumption for supporting/passive devices without measurements.
External services and threat records are not automatically energy functions; model their host equipment separately if energy-accounted.

carbonExtension.safetyPrecedence: Carbon objectives cannot override protection, operating constraints or approved authority.

remaining: Acquire/verify the official UML archive and applicable reaffirmation/errata mapping
Review exact properties, multiplicities, units, inheritance and conformance blocks
Instantiate typed device/function bindings and actual protocol adapters
Verify simulation, runtime behavior and authentic admission evidence
